# AXM AetherFX v1.1 Expansion Packages

Two sealed declarative packages provide the new high-end illusion systems:

- `mold.cinematic-glass-stage.axmfx.json` — liquid glass, aurora, fog, dust, guidance, and depth.
- `mold.prismatic-product-card.axmfx.json` — crystal surface, spectral dispersion, edge light, spring response, and focus.

Each package includes its full dependency closure and SHA-256 integrity metadata. Public licensing remains intentionally unset.
